summary: Juz'iyyah refers to the quality of being a part, portion, or division. It denotes particularity or the relation to a specific segment rather than the whole.
lane: [ جُزْئِيَّةٌ ذ The quality of relating to a part or portion or division; relation to a part &c.; particularity. ]
